## Use the words

::: {.recall lines="2"}
- What is our {{< vocab "goal" zh=true >}} for this unit? | To use English in class every day.
- Write one question to {{< vocab "discuss" zh=true >}} with a {{< vocab "partner" zh=true >}}. | What did you learn today?
- Write a one-sentence {{< vocab "summary" zh=true >}} of today's lesson. | Today we learned four words for working in class.
:::
